name: Eveready East Africa Plc
source: Eveready East Africa Plc audited financial results for the year ended 30 Sep 2021 (published 2022). Headline figures only - the two-column source PDF text is scrambled, so interim P&L lines are not reliably extractable.
source_note: Revenue and loss for the year verified from 'Performance at a Glance' (2021 sales KES 90m, loss after tax KES 35m; 2020 sales KES 134m, loss KES 69m) and the statement of changes in equity (loss for year 34,691 / 69,010). EPS in KShs. Year-end 30 September.
